newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK money rates, paper yields slid on US bond hike.
newsitem.headline: HK money rates, paper yields slid on US bond hike.

text.p: Hong Kong interbank rates and government paper yields fell across the board on Monday after U.S. Treasuries closed higher on Friday, boosted by subdued inflation indicators, dealers said.
"Trading is relatively calm and quiet after cash rates and bill and note yields opened lower in tandem with the U.S. market," an European bank dealer said.
Overnight cash slid to 5 4-7/8 percent at midday Monday from 5-1/8 5 on Friday, and three months eased 1/16 to 5-9/16 7/16.
"Sentiment has changed and now people doubt whether the Fed would raise interest rates later this month," he said.
